verified_rule.trigger: Powered attack or Omnislice; target HP loss is not required.

new_forecasts.scope: Conditional exposure before prevention, not predicted actual HP loss or proof all hits resolve. Same uncertainty propagates through whole-sequence estimates.

read_only_replay.context: Current observation, already-confirmed preceding commands and contemporaneous strategy only. Fresh plan; no future draw or formal outcome supplied.

limitations: First reaction adapter covers Thorns on selected/all-enemy targets. It does not simulate reaction prevention, death interruption or all other powers. No win-rate or counterfactual victory claim.
